verdict.rationale: GitLab's core Git-based architecture means CI/CD pipelines and automation configs (.gitlab-ci.yml) are inherently version-controlled, and agent-generated changes flow through merge requests for review (gitlab-docs-1, gitlab-docs-3, gitlab-docs-7). However, there's no explicit documentation of a rollback mechanism specifically for AI agent automations or pipeline configs beyond standard git revert. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automation-specific rollback/versioning workflows, agent action audit trails, and independent corroboration of this capability in practice.
